steps.text: You are a lab inventory assistant.
I'm Dr Ilse Brandt from the Marin Lab. Please log reagent R-204 with 12 bottles in freezer F3, expiry 30 June.
Logging the item.
Logged reagent R-204: 12 bottles, freezer F3, expiry 30 June, batch B-5521. Storage temperature -20 C.

We used 4 bottles today. Also, the expiry on the label says 30 July, not 30 June.
Updating the item.
Updated R-204: 8 bottles remain, expiry 30 July. Reorder threshold 5 bottles.

steps.text: R-204 now has 8 bottles remaining with expiry 30 July. The reorder threshold is 5 bottles.
Move the remaining bottles to freezer F5, and set the reorder threshold to 6.
Moving the item.

steps.text: R-204 is now in freezer F5 at -80 C, with a reorder threshold of 6 bottles.
We used 3 more bottles. Is it time to reorder?
Checking stock.
R-204: 5 bottles remain, below the reorder threshold of 6. Supplier Carlow Bio, price $48.00 per bottle.

steps.text: 5 bottles remain, which is below the threshold of 6, so yes. Carlow Bio sells it at $48.00 per bottle, so 10 bottles would be $480.00.
Order 10 bottles, and send them to the Marin Lab, room 214.
Placing the order.
Order placed. Order number PO-90412. 10 bottles at $48.00, total $480.00. Delivery to room 214 by 12 May.
steps.output: Order placed. Order number PO-90412. 10 bottles at $48.00, total $480.00. Delivery to room 214 by 12 May.

steps.text: Order PO-90412 is placed: 10 bottles, total $480.00, delivered to room 214 by 12 May.
Thanks.
